candidate.rationale: The generic implementation only exposes the `DeepViewClone` guarantee, which exactly yields the inherited `ToOwned::get_owned` postcondition. Option-shape or inner deep-view clauses are consequences of that contract, so no non-redundant postcondition is available.
risks: Executable equality with `*self` is unsound because `DeepViewClone` permits distinct hidden state with the same deep view.
Variant-preservation clauses would merely restate consequences of the inherited deep-view equality.
